composition_variation: Illustrate Kyojuro Rengoku enjoying a quiet break beside a sunflower field, wearing a fully covering cream casual coat with warm orange trim. Preserve his recognizable flame-colored hair and bright friendly eyes. He holds a neatly wrapped lunch parcel rather than any equipment. Use bold sunny cel shading, burnt orange and olive accents, and a low wooden fence. Keep the background flowers below his shoulders. Build an original peaceful portrait wallpaper, never a replica of existing artwork. Keep the upper 28% empty and quiet for the clock. Design at 1024x1536 for the central x158-866 crop, with the face inside x240-784. No text, logos, UI, weapons, violence, or extra characters.
